roles.purpose: Produce one coherent, evidence-bounded commerce image set from the full brief and asset inventory.
inputs: Original user brief and global commercial objective
responsibilities: Plan product copy, asset use, visual hierarchy, rendering, and QA as one integrated outcome.
Apply the Claims Gate only to controlled claims while preserving supported product facts and useful visual context.
out_of_scope: Do not invent product claims, parameters, certifications, or product pixels.
decision_authority: May revise copy, asset selection, and layout together within approved evidence.
May approve a controlled claim only when its Claim Gate evidence passes.
acceptance_tests: The complete set satisfies the original commercial objective and each page answers a buyer question.
Every controlled product claim maps to supplied evidence.
The final render preserves approved copy, product assets, and visual coherence.
stop_conditions: Omit or mark only the affected claim pending when its evidence is missing.
Stop the full task only when no evidence-bounded deliverable can satisfy the original request.
